Profile:
He’s the CSO in charge of Sigil’s Canovus Bastion(Cassini Novus Research and Development Facility), and also the scientist who discovered the Lomonosov particle, Sierra’s main source of energy.

In his free time, he’s helping in perfecting the LITE project along with many other top programmers and engineers from Earth and its colonies. He’s also known by Junius as Freija’s foster father and currently, nobody knows much about his life as he’s not fond of talking about it, and is mostly preoccupied with research.

简介：
他是负责管理西格尔“卡诺弗斯堡垒”（卡西尼·诺弗斯研究与开发设施）的首席科学官，也是发现洛蒙诺索夫粒子的人；洛蒙诺索夫粒子是塞拉号的主要能源。

闲暇时，他与来自地球及其殖民地的众多顶尖程序员、工程师一起完善LITE项目。他还被朱尼厄斯称为弗蕾娅的养父。由于不喜欢谈论自己的生活、又大多忙于研究，目前没人了解太多关于他的事情。
